name: @postwave/notifications
description: Single source of truth for Moosewave notification categories — one manifest mapping every server event (approval.requested, campaign.sent, subscriber.bounced, …) to its category, title/body templates, deep-link entity, default-enabled flag, and per-channel (push/desktop/web) eligibility, so notification copy + routing stop being duplicated mobile-only-by-convention.
author: Moosewave
